metaDescription: Order custom plastic carry on bags for bulk events. Perfect for security-friendly travel gear. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Plastic carry on bags offer a lightweight, durable, and often transparent solution for travelers who need to speed through airport security. Unlike fabric bags, these clear or translucent options make contents visible at a glance, which is especially useful for trade show giveaways or corporate travel kits. The 12" x 12" x 6" Security Approved Poly Draw Tape Bag is a prime example, meeting TSA guidelines while providing ample space for toiletries or electronics. Custom imprinting on the front panel ensures your logo travels everywhere your team goes.
heroAltText: Custom plastic carry on bags with clear poly material and drawstring closure, ideal for travel and corporate gifts.
